memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin D deficiency.
Patient reports fatigue and occasional muscle aches; examination shows mild proximal muscle tenderness, no bony deformities. Smoking status: never (0 pack-years). Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D pending; calcium and phosphate within normal limits.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then cholecalciferol 1000 IU once daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 12 ng/mL (ref 30‑100).
Serum calcium: 9.2 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5).
Serum phosphate: 3.4 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin D deficiency, ongoing.
Patient adheres to weekly high‑dose cholecalciferol; reports reduced fatigue, no new symptoms. Exam: mild proximal tenderness improved. Smoking status: never (0 pack-years).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then cholecalciferol 1000 IU once daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 22 ng/mL (ref 30‑100).
Serum calcium: 9.3 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5).
Serum phosphate: 3.5 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin D deficiency, improving.
Patient feels well, no musculoskeletal pain; takes cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily. Exam: normal muscle tone, no tenderness. Smoking status: never (0 pack-years).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 38 ng/mL (ref 30‑100).
Serum calcium: 9.4 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5).
Serum phosphate: 3.6 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling a bit more tired lately and notice occasional lower back ache after long hours at the desk. Wondering if my vitamin D levels have dropped again.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2026-04-05 at 10:30 am with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin D deficiency, stable.
Patient reports mild fatigue and occasional back ache; exam shows no tenderness, normal strength. Smoking status: never (0 pack-years). Decision to repeat vitamin D level.
